**Email Thread regarding ContactTech Offer:**
This thread involves a recipient, their assistant, and ContactTech HR (represented by Usher). ContactTech HR requested offer confirmation via email. The recipient asked their assistant to handle the confirmation. The assistant sent the word "confirmation" to the specified email address (contact@contact.com) on behalf of the recipient. ContactTech HR followed up to ensure receipt. The thread concludes with a formal offer letter from Usher, reiterating the need for confirmation and providing privacy and terms of service information.
